messages:
Sara K: quick async check — canary roll at 5% in prod as of 09:05. Observed CPU + tail-latency spike on a small subset of nodes. What I did: swapped the new kernel flag, restarted two pods in slice-b, tightened cpu request. Blockers: still seeing a handful of 99th pct spikes. Asking SRE for log correlation.
Miguel R: pushed a quick metric patch to include kv-cache hit rate in the canary dashboard. Should show up in ~2m. Also added a /canary/health endpoint to the slice router.
Jordan (SRE): looking now. Can you paste the pod ids? I’ll correlate with infra alerts.
Sara K: pod ids: 
```
slice-b-7f6d4c9d8c-2q9lm
slice-b-7f6d4c9d8c-4pf2t
slice-b-7f6d4c9d8c-6h1zr
```
Miguel R: saw an increase in kernel context switches around the same timestamps — might be related to a batched client pattern spike. I’ll throttle small-batch clients if we confirm.
Amy P (PM): heads up — product metrics are holding steady, feature flags show ~5% user exposure. No support tickets yet. @Sara K please keep me posted if the 99th > 1.2s for more than 10m.
Lee Q (QA): I ran the canary test-suite against the running canary image at 09:10 — no functional regressions. Saw a transient auth timeout in one test, but it retried cleanly.
deploy-bot: Rollout event: canary slice-b -> 5% at 2024-05-03T09:05:00Z. Monitoring window open.
Jordan (SRE): correlated pods with infra alerts — nodes ip-10-2-14-xx had higher steal. Looks like noisy neighbor on that host. I’m moving the affected pods to new hosts now.
Sara K: thanks. I’ll pause further traffic expansion until we confirm stabilization. Can we try rebalancing and then re-run the kv-cache hotkey analyzer?
Miguel R: rebalanced pods; new placement IDs: slice-b-7f6d4c9d8c-9t2xz, slice-b-7f6d4c9d8c-1m7qa. Kvcache analyzer queued.
Jordan (SRE): rebalancing done. Removing node ip-10-2-14-xx from autoscale pool for investigation.
Sara K: current quick checklist for teams —
- SRE: confirm node health + infra alerts cleared
- Eng-runtime: watch 99th and kv-cache hit rate for next 15m
- QA: run smoke path tests on the new pods
- PM: hold on expanding feature flag until green
Amy P (PM): will hold. If all checks pass, plan to go to 20% at 09:45.
Lee Q (QA): smoke tests queued, will post results.
Miguel R: kv-cache hit rate is back to baseline after rebalance (~+1.2%). No obvious regression in token throughput.
Sara K: thanks everyone. If anything degrades flip the flag: `ffctl set canary_slice_b false` — I’ll monitor and send a final status in ~15m. :thumbsup:
Lee Q (QA): smoke tests green on new pods at 09:25. No flakiness observed.
Jordan (SRE): infra alerts cleared at 09:28. 99th latency trending down.
Sara K: status update — stable at 5% for 20m, 99th within target. Scheduling 20% expand in 15m unless objections.
Amy P (PM): go ahead at +15 if metrics hold.
Miguel R: will monitor live dashboards for the ramp and /canary/health endpoint.
Sara K: final note — leaving a quick postmortem todo: improve node placement heuristics to avoid noisy neighbors during canaries. I’ll open a short RFC tomorrow.
Miguel R: good call.
Amy P (PM): thanks team.
Sara K: closing thread for now, will update after the 20% ramp. :rocket:
